findings.desc: decision_doc_save scope guard can be bypassed conceptually because it accepts current checklist file declarations after the scope contract fails. checklist_update permits files updates in DEV, while decision_doc_save is also DEV-only, so a DEV actor can add docs/requirements/decisions/<slug>.md to checklist files and then save without a PLAN-frozen scope contract or accepted scope extension. This violates the product boundary that save must not become a back door for expanding story scope during DEV.

CHK-001 adversarial / CHK-004 adversarial require preview to be read-only for story metadata, process events, and project docs, but the smoke only snapshots decision-doc-proposals.json and the target doc around decision_doc_preview. It does not snapshot process-events.jsonl or store.readProcessEvents before/after preview, so a regression that appends a decision_doc_preview process event would still pass. Evidence: packages/main/src/tasks/decision-doc-promotion-smoke.ts:226-233 checks proposal metadata and target absence only; handler path under review is packages/main/src/handlers/decision-doc-promotion.ts:410-423.
